RESIDENTIAL PURCHASE AND SALE AGREEMENT

THIS AGREEMENT is made this 8th day of April, 2026, by and between:

SELLER: Douglas H. and Patricia N. Kwan, husband and wife, of 1418 Alder Ridge Drive, Bellevue, WA 98004
BUYER: Everett J. Osterhaus and Priya Rao Osterhaus, husband and wife, of 3320 Fremont Avenue N, Apt. 402, Seattle, WA 98103

1. PROPERTY. Seller agrees to sell and Buyer agrees to purchase the real property located at 1418 Alder Ridge Drive, Bellevue, King County, Washington 98004, legally described as Lot 7, Block 3, Alder Ridge Estates, according to plat recorded in Volume 118 of Plats, Pages 24–27, records of King County, Washington. Tax Parcel No. 054730-0070-04.

2. PURCHASE PRICE. Total purchase price: $1,875,000.00, payable as follows:
   (a) Earnest money: $37,500 deposited within 3 business days with Cascade Escrow, LLC (Escrow Officer: Naomi Tolentino).
   (b) Additional earnest money: $50,000 released to Seller as non-refundable consideration upon expiration of the Inspection Period, subject to Sections 6 and 8.
   (c) Balance: $1,787,500 in cash at Closing.

3. FINANCING CONTINGENCY. Buyer's obligation is contingent on Buyer obtaining a conventional 30-year loan of not less than $1,406,250 at an interest rate not to exceed 7.25%, on or before May 20, 2026 ("Loan Contingency Deadline"). Buyer shall submit a complete loan application within 7 days of mutual acceptance. If Buyer notifies Seller in writing before the Loan Contingency Deadline of Buyer's inability to obtain financing, all earnest money shall be refunded to Buyer.

4. TITLE. Seller shall convey marketable title by statutory warranty deed, subject only to the exceptions listed on the Preliminary Commitment for Title Insurance to be issued by First American Title Insurance Company. Seller shall pay for a standard coverage owner's title policy in the amount of the purchase price.

5. INSPECTIONS. Buyer shall have until 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time on April 29, 2026 (the "Inspection Period") to conduct at Buyer's expense any inspections Buyer deems appropriate, including but not limited to a general home inspection, sewer scope, radon test, and pest inspection. Buyer may terminate this Agreement for any reason during the Inspection Period by written notice, in which event all earnest money shall be refunded.

6. SELLER DISCLOSURES. Seller has delivered a completed Form 17 Seller Disclosure Statement dated April 6, 2026. Seller specifically discloses: (a) a 2019 partial roof replacement (rear slope only) by Cascade Peak Roofing; (b) an active seasonal spring on the northwest corner of the parcel; and (c) a 2022 insurance claim for water damage in the basement resulting from a failed water heater, which has been fully remediated by ServPro of Bellevue (invoice #78912).

7. LEAD-BASED PAINT. Property was constructed in 1968. Buyer acknowledges receipt of the EPA pamphlet "Protect Your Family From Lead in Your Home" and the Lead-Based Paint Disclosure Addendum.

8. CLOSING. Closing shall occur on or before June 12, 2026, at the offices of Cascade Escrow, LLC. Seller shall deliver possession at Closing.

9. PRORATIONS. Real estate taxes, HOA dues ($285/quarter to Alder Ridge Estates HOA), and utilities shall be prorated as of the Closing Date.

10. DEFAULT. If Buyer defaults, Seller's sole remedy is retention of the earnest money as liquidated damages. If Seller defaults, Buyer may either (a) receive a refund of earnest money or (b) seek specific performance.

11. AGENCY DISCLOSURE. Listing broker: Aurelia Chen, Windermere Bellevue (License No. 79412). Selling broker: Marcus Beauchamp, Redfin (License No. 82117). Commission of 5% of the purchase price shall be paid by Seller at Closing.

12. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Washington.

SELLER: /s/ Douglas H. Kwan    /s/ Patricia N. Kwan       Date: April 8, 2026
BUYER:  /s/ Everett J. Osterhaus  /s/ Priya Rao Osterhaus    Date: April 8, 2026
